meta.name: Supplement to parameters_baseline.json: values the database states only in prose, plus model idealizations
meta.policy: Every entry here is an ASSUMPTION or is quoted from a used_for/notes/range field of parameters_baseline.json. Each is listed in docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md. Nothing here is published data.

fairing_jettison_mass.used_for: Part of m_bay dropped at fairing jettison; the remainder (m_bay - m_fair = 500 kg at baseline) goes to orbit.
fairing_jettison_mass.notes: Range = JSON m_bay range (1,700-2,600 kg) minus the 500 kg retained part. Not swept in this study.

fairing_jettison_dynamic_pressure.source: parameters_baseline.json upper_stage.payload_bay_overhead.used_for ('when dynamic pressure falls below 10 Pa')
fairing_jettison_dynamic_pressure.used_for: Fairing is jettisoned at the first downward crossing of q = q_fair after liftoff.
fairing_jettison_dynamic_pressure.notes: Prescribed by the team's JSON; not swept.

ascent_cd_scale.used_for: Multiplies the ascent Cd(M) table. Calibration knob 1 (expendable N = 9 payload anchor).
ascent_cd_scale.notes: Value is replaced by the calibrated value in every production run; see results/*/manifest.json.

landing_accel_cap_basis.used_for: Which acceleration the landing cap a_max_land limits: 'thrust_plus_drag' = |T + D|/m (database definition, BASELINE) or 'thrust_only' = T/m (DLR-style T/W reading of S17; alternative for the team to decide).
landing_accel_cap_basis.notes: Switch exists because the database definition makes N = 9 unable to land (see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md A-CAP).

launch_pad_altitude.source: assumption (pad at sea level; SLC-40 pad elevation is not in the database)
launch_pad_altitude.used_for: Initial altitude of the ascent and the landing (drone-ship deck) altitude.
launch_pad_altitude.notes: Drone-ship deck height and pad elevation (a few metres) are neglected.
